dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Hey, dude, you told Granny about the opening ceremony, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Of course, but all she said was: "Playtime's for children." And after she said that, I didn't have the courage to tell her even the Pyro Archon agreed to come.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, guess we could still bring her back a gift. Maybe an Asha headband? Not sure if that's her vibe...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Snacks might be a safer choice. Granny always needs something to nibble on while she's reading... or drinking...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Hmm, we'd better get Cacucu's opinion on this... Speaking of, where even is that dude? Still hanging out with the Asha?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Hehe. Don't worry bro, Cacucu can take care of himself.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Do you even hear yourself, bro? I'm more worried those Asha are gonna be all "bro-ified" once he's done with them...
